Infrastructure.notes: Uses primary department and explicit complaint-language evidence. Publisher aspects are audit context only because they often include unrelated secondary tags. Remaining physical infrastructure maps to Maintenance.

urgency_rules.critical_override: Only Falcon Mail safety-emergency keywords elevate a record to Critical.

review_policy: Every decision is retained in corpus_v2_review.csv with original labels and a review note. Unmapped labels are excluded rather than coerced.
